scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Agent missed verbatim scripts for: Greeting

scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Verify the customer's identity and confirm their account information to ensure you're assisting the correct person.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Use empathetic language and acknowledge the customer's concern to show understanding and build trust.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Paraphrase the customer's issue to ensure you understand their problem and to show that you're actively listening.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: Use polite language and maintain a professional tone to build rapport and establish trust with the customer.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Ask diagnostic questions to gather more information about the customer's problem and to clarify their concerns.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Take ownership of the issue and avoid blaming other departments or the customer to show accountability and responsibility.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: Explicitly confirm that the issue is resolved to ensure the customer feels satisfied and to prevent future issues.
